verses.text: "Speak to Aaron, his sons, and all the people of Israel. Tell them this is what the LORD has commanded:
Any Israelite who kills a bull, a lamb, or a goat, inside the camp or outside it,

and does not bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it as a gift to the LORD in front of his Holy Tent, is guilty of shedding blood. He has shed blood, and he must be cut off from his people.

This is so that the people of Israel will bring to the LORD the animals they have been killing as offerings out in the open fields. They must bring them to the priest at the door of the Tent of Meeting and offer them to the LORD as peace offerings.
The priest will splash the blood on the LORD's altar at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and burn the fat as a smell that pleases the LORD.
They must no longer offer their animals to the goat idols, which they have chased after like an unfaithful wife. This is a rule forever for them and for all their families to come.
Tell them also: Any Israelite, or any foreigner living among them, who offers a burnt offering or any other offering
and does not bring it to the door of the Tent of Meeting to offer it to the LORD, must be cut off from his people.
If any Israelite, or any foreigner living among them, eats any blood at all, I will turn against that person and cut him off from his people.
For the life of a living body is in the blood. I have given you the blood on the altar to make you right with me. It is the blood, because it is life, that makes people right with God.
That is why I have told the people of Israel, 'None of you may eat blood, and no foreigner living among you may eat blood.'
If any Israelite, or any foreigner living among them, hunts and catches an animal or bird that may be eaten, he must pour out its blood and cover it with dust.

For the life of every creature is its blood. That is why I have told the people of Israel, 'Do not eat the blood of any creature, because the life of every creature is its blood. Anyone who eats it must be cut off.'

Anyone, whether born in the land or a foreigner, who eats an animal that died by itself or was killed by wild animals must wash his clothes and bathe in water. He will be unclean until evening, and then he will be clean.
But if he does not wash his clothes and bathe his body, he will carry the blame."
